title: Behavior-preserving refactoring
summary: Change structure without changing behavior: pin current behavior first, move in small verified steps and stop when the diff starts to carry intent changes.

provenance.notes: Adds the stop rule: a refactor that needs a test edit is not a refactor.

inputs.name: pinning-tests
inputs.description: Tests that already pin the behavior.

outputs.name: risk-notes
outputs.description: Anything whose behavior could not be shown unchanged.

workflow.step: Run or read the tests that cover the code to be moved; if none exist, stop and recommend characterization tests first.
workflow.check: Current behavior is pinned before any edit.

workflow.step: Choose one mechanical transformation at a time: rename, extract, inline, move.
workflow.check: Each step is small enough to review by eye.

workflow.step: After each step re-run the pinning tests unchanged.
workflow.check: No test file appears in the diff.

workflow.step: Compare public signatures, error values and ordering before and after; list any difference.
workflow.check: Any difference is reported, not hidden.

workflow.step: Stop and escalate if the change needs a test edit, a signature change outside scope or a behavior decision.

constraints: Never mix a refactor with a bug fix or feature in the same change.
Do not edit tests to make a refactor pass.

examples.title: Extract helper
examples.situation: A 120-line function repeats a validation block.
examples.guidance: Extract the block, rerun the tests, and confirm the error text is byte-identical.

verification: The diff contains no behavior change or is reported as such.

task.text: Refactor: extract function from the long handler and remove duplicate validation.
Review this cleanup and rename for hidden behavior changes.
